description: Overlay plus every tool window. Every window label must match something here — a window that is absent gets no permissions at all, so window.__TAURI__.opener is never injected and tauriBridge.js dies on its first destructure, leaving a blank window. details-* covers the per-fight windows, which are labelled by fight id; pw_* covers plugin widgets (pw_<plugin>_<widget>). dashboard is the window that runs every plugin (plugins/bundled.rs); main, the meter's window, is the overlay over the game that holds the meter and every plugin's widgets (plugins/overlay.rs).
